name: matt-poteto-addy
description: Matt plans/specifies/tickets; original poteto-mode implements/tests/prepares PRs; selected Addy skills cover lifecycle disciplines.

rationale.entry_points: Use setup-agentic-workflow only. Standalone Matt/pstack setup skills are removed; their required instructions/templates are non-skill references bundled with the coordinator.
rationale.on_demand: Original helper bodies/resources are present for the documented planning, architecture, execution/review and maintenance paths, but are outside host skill-discovery directories.
rationale.principles: Poteto-mode explicitly requires its 24 original principle leaf files. Keep them available without adding 24 discovery descriptions.
rationale.resources: Preserve skill-local resources, Addy's root-shared references, original pstack agent roles and its documented Claude tool adapter. Do not ship whole package archives, plugin catalogs, hooks, automations, demos or unrelated productivity/bot/formal-verification skills.
rationale.ui: frontend-design and ui-ux-pro-max remain checked external dependencies, as previously agreed; no silent download, substitution or rebranding.
